entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Phew, I'm stuffed.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I gotta eat good because I'm[n]fighting a war.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Didn't I tell you? I've been having[n]serious battles with kids at school.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: They attack me in large numbers,[n]so I can't let my guard down.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: All they did today was throw[n]eraser crumbs into my lunch,[n]though, so I won that round.
Are they bullying you?
Sounds like fun.
You shouldn't waste food.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...It's a war.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's not. There's nothing fun about war.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Tell that to the kids who did it.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm on the defensive right now, but I'm[n]looking for a chance to counterattack.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I could finish them in a second if I[n]put my mind to it.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's just that... now's not the right time.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It gets kind of annoying having to[n]watch my back all the time, though...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Maybe I can ask the Phantom Thieves to[n]take care of them...

entries.speaker: Crying Grade Schooler
entries.en: *sob* *sob*

entries.speaker: Kind Mother
entries.en: Your food is here, sweetheart.

entries.speaker: Kind Mother
entries.en: Well, today you lost...

entries.speaker: Kind Mother
entries.en: So that means you'll just have to[n]try harder next time. Now, eat up[n]and feel better.

entries.speaker: Crying Grade Schooler
entries.en: ...You're not mad?

entries.speaker: Kind Mother
entries.en: Of course not. You did your best,[n]and that's all that counts.

entries.speaker: Kind Mother
entries.en: Now, no more crying.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What a joke... Once you lose, it's over.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's what my mom told me.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom's fighting with my school...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: About how classes are taught,[n]the way teachers treat students,[n]the size of the classes...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Since the divorce, my mom's been[n]taking care of me all by herself.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She says it's exhausting.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She leaves really early to go to work.[n]Then she comes home really late to[n]take care of me.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's no wonder she demands so much[n]from the school, you know?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But all of my classmates make fun[n]of her and call her a complainer...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: When I tell them to stop, they call me a[n]momma's boy...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's how the war started.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom gets made fun of because[n]I'm weak!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's why I gotta get stronger!
That's the spirit.[clr 27]
Want to learn martial arts?
You really love your mom.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, the Phantom Thieves would[n]laugh at me if I lost now.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But I've got a long way to go...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...No. I could get hurt.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Besides, violence is bad.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Everyone should just play Gun About.[n]Then I'd be the best.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...If you call me a momma's boy, then[n]I'm not gonna teach you how to play[n]Gun About anymore!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, before I forget, I need to show you[n]something...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Don't tell anyone else about this, okay?[n]But I'm going to show you a guaranteed[n]way to win!
I feel like my bond with[n]Shinya is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I wish I could be a member of the[n]Phantom Thieves and help them[n]defeat the bad guys in the world.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, it's kinda late.[n]I guess I should go home...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Thanks for the food. Later!
